text: Chapter 6: The Two Technista@The Town of Pax Faction
■Next Mission\nStart by moving to Einklang from Polde Ice Valley, which is\nnext to Calle Mort.
You can't use Spina in Einklang.\nLet's find a store that accepts Spina to buy something.
Let's collect information of the situation in Einklang and\nthe empire of Lyark Technista from the people in the town.
Yungo is repairing cannons at Artillery Defense Line.\nLet's protect him from monsters!
Yungo's Golem, Iconos can't recognize him and is trying to\nattack Yungo! Let's stop Iconos to save Yungo!
[[N]]Let's find a shop that accepts Spina!
